# Punkti 0.6 normative freeze-candidate vectors

Generated by `src/make_vectors.py`; neither implementation is imported into this process.
These vectors are a freeze candidate, not a release or freeze approval.

## Encoding and execution

All `*_utf8` strings below denote exact UTF-8 bytes after JSON string unescaping.
`body_utf8` is the exact HTTP request body; `target` is the exact request target.
HTTP uses loopback with dynamic ports; Host and transport header order are not normative.
Adapter commands use JSON-lines; import_json receives base64 of the exact UTF-8 bytes.
The seed is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 literal `punkti-0.6-freeze-vectors`:
`623d095ee124c3c8270c69bdfaa98f0930527f7cc0b4140d05afd3cb5bd6ba7d`. No timestamps, ports or random epochs enter this artifact.
Server epochs are runtime values: compare tokens to that server’s HELLO epoch,
and echo complete returned tokens. Canonical atom JSON member order is not normative.
Error message text and implementation-specific error envelopes are not normative;
HTTP statuses, classifications, admissions and state transitions asserted here are.
V5 empty PUSH is labelled non_normative and excluded from the 10-vector normative total.
A seeded fixture means adapter add(spec), with admitted=true and exact canonical fields checked.
V7 import_json returns only ok/error by contract: accepted JSON is checked against the
pinned atom and independently minted zero-timestamp C/R; the import return bytes are not exposed.

## Canonical fixtures

All canonical fields below are cross-checked against both independent mint/signing paths.
C and S are hex; R and sig are canonical base64. sha256_R covers the exact R bytes.
The zero fixture is the canonical zero-timestamp fixture for V7.

## V1 — canonical-record

Import exact JSON; decode R; push twice into empty node.

VALID; canonical values equal pinned fixture; complete framing; first admission then duplicate.

**State transition:** Empty → one VALID record/log entry → unchanged on duplicate.

Exact inputs and machine-checkable expectations:

```json
{
  "id": "V1",
  "title": "canonical-record",
  "input": {
    "description": "Import exact JSON; decode R; push twice into empty node.",
    "fixture": "canonical",
    "json_utf8": "{\"alg\":\"ed25519\",\"ext\":\"AP8A\",\"h\":\"s00000000000\",\"pk\":\"n9wUpwhUac6RE1EaIDOs9Vk9bpzasYzydwtYiARPGmY=\",\"refs\":[{\"rel\":\"unrecognized/\\u5173\\u7cfb\",\"target\":\"unknown/a:00ff\"},{\"rel\":\"\",\"target\":\"future/v9:abcd\"}],\"sig\":\"lhi9DD5hYgxV54ogMMySzcMNc+GK2ij0+bq5rb4SMxu7IY9nyxgxdDar45SbJiHPfFRz4KBs6Yh33L2f4VgmDw==\",\"t\":1700000000000,\"v\":\"punkti/0.6\",\"x\":\"opaque freeze payload \\u0000 \\u4e16\\u754c \\ud83c\\udf0d\"}",
    "request": {
      "method": "POST",
      "target": "/push",
      "body_utf8": "{\"records\":[{\"address\":\"punkti/0.6:0224ff9b877ba0e74c7f103a7f32108e0393ea67a97abce136238c4d313dd895\",\"record\":\"\",\"sha256\":\"67023bf50908620e2b57bd0b413e3becaa7264585fb78043f6472caabc0e87ac\"}]}"
    }
  },
  "expected": {
    "description": "VALID; canonical values equal pinned fixture; complete framing; first admission then duplicate.",
    "import_ok": true,
    "state": "VALID",
    "http_status": 200,
    "admitted": [
      true,
      false
    ],
    "duplicate_reason": "duplicate"
  },
  "state_transition": {
    "description": "Empty \u2192 one VALID record/log entry \u2192 unchanged on duplicate.",
    "final_per_node": {
      "valid": 1,
      "candidates": 0,
      "log": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## V2 — initial-mid-cursor

Empty MID request twice; empty spatial; seed three fixtures then two MID pages, echoing the first token.

Empty MID after=null, empty spatial after=0; nonempty MID after=[address,sha256_R]; repeated empty request identical.

**State transition:** PULL does not change store/candidates/log/epoch.

Exact inputs and machine-checkable expectations:

```json
{
  "id": "V2",
  "title": "initial-mid-cursor",
  "input": {
    "description": "Empty MID request twice; empty spatial; seed three fixtures then two MID pages, echoing the first token.",
    "fixtures": [
      "spatial0",
      "spatial1",
      "spatial2"
    ],
    "empty_mid": {
      "method": "GET",
      "target": "/pull?q=%7B%22mode%22%3A%22mid%22%7D",
      "query": {
        "mode": "mid"
      }
    },
    "empty_spatial": {
      "method": "GET",
      "target": "/pull?q=%7B%22limit%22%3A1%2C%22mode%22%3A%22spatial%22%7D",
      "query": {
        "mode": "spatial",
        "limit": 1
      }
    },
    "first": {
      "method": "GET",
      "target": "/pull?q=%7B%22limit%22%3A1%2C%22mode%22%3A%22mid%22%7D",
      "query": {
        "mode": "mid",
        "limit": 1
      }
    },
    "continuation": "Same first query plus cursor equal to the complete first response token."
  },
  "expected": {
    "description": "Empty MID after=null, empty spatial after=0; nonempty MID after=[address,sha256_R]; repeated empty request identical.",
    "http_status": 200,
    "empty_records": [],
    "empty_end": true,
    "empty_mid_after": null,
    "empty_spatial_after": 0,
    "page_addresses": [
      "punkti/0.6:b8da0a3c616083fada8f7b5cc5c90faba1e2d1ba6719e96a05979a5d8ebee00e",
      "punkti/0.6:efa769042ad022b66eaca4aa5cceae58d420f8baf546e7cadd2806fd2e749eaa"
    ],
    "scope_pattern": "[0-9a-f]{64}"
  },
  "state_transition": {
    "description": "PULL does not change store/candidates/log/epoch.",
    "final_per_node": {
      "valid": 3,
      "candidates": 0,
      "log": 3
    }
  }
}
```

## V3 — range-rejection

Equal/reversed bounds reject; single unbounded endpoints accept.
